name: can-loopback-routing-suite
description: Verifies the gateway's send-to-wire-to-receive CAN frame path on real hardware: payload integrity, per-frame latency (<1ms), and no drops -- using can0/can1 wired onto one shared physical bus as a DUT-free stand-in.

tests.name: can0->can1 routing: payload, latency, no drops
tests.description: 100 sequence-tagged frames sent via the gateway on can0, observed arriving on can1 via raw SocketCAN.
